title: 第1016章 七年闭关准备离开玄灵界第1015章 刘安的歹毒计划楚峰出手
content_zh:
“给本王继续，我就不信，他能将所有的傀儡都给收了！”
刘安立刻下达命令。
一具具傀儡在设定了自爆时间后，被投入了飞升通道之中。
早就守候多时庞烈心念一动，将这些傀儡尽数的转移到了黑色洞口前。
“吞，吞，吞！”
楚峰则来者不拒，将所有的傀儡都给收入了吞天葫中，然后立刻封印其自爆力量。
就这么，几十息时间，楚峰足足收了近十具傀儡。
“哈哈，这刘安简直就是送财童子啊，一下子就送了这么多的傀儡过来！”
楚峰大笑。
这些傀儡可都具备道台境的实力。
如果能全部掌握了，他又将多出一个大底牌。
这么多傀儡一起自爆，就算是归一境的强者，恐怕也得掂量掂量。
“太好了，楚峰，你这个空间宝物简直他娘的太好用了……”
庞烈也是跟着兴奋起来。
这么多的傀儡，如果全部都被那刘安头下来自爆，他定然会吃不消。
玄灵界的世界本源将会再度被消耗。
整个玄灵界将永无宁日。
“别掉以轻心，还没完，那刘安绝不会轻易罢休的！”
楚峰满脸严肃的说道。
“放心，我的元神力一直都在关注着飞升通道中的情况……”

庞烈点了点头。
“老庞，你先盯着，我去一下空间宝物中！”
楚峰叮嘱了庞烈之后，身形一闪进入了本源塔中。
随后拿出吞天葫，进入了其中。
吞天葫中，十具傀儡一字排开矗立在造化轮盘上。
“该给他们一个大礼了……”
他将元神力散发而出，烙印在其中一具傀儡上。
既然对方能引爆傀儡，他自然也能。
到时候，一具傀儡抵达飞升通道出口自爆，就算炸不死他们，也能将他们惊退，让他们不敢轻举妄动。
与此同时，飞升通道出口，刘安等一行人脸色阴沉。
他们手中还有傀儡，但却并不敢动用。
按照他们推算，别说十具了，无具傀儡就足以让玄灵界本源枯竭。
可现在，都已经投入十具了，加上之前爆炸了的两具，足足有十二具了。
可玄灵界不仅没有崩溃，反而愈发强大。
content_en:
"Keep going, I don't believe that he can take over all the puppets!"
Liu An immediately issued the order.
Each puppet was thrown into the ascension channel after setting the self-destruction time.
Pang Lie, who had been waiting for a long time, moved all these puppets to the entrance of the black hole with a thought.
"Swallow, swallow, swallow!"
Chu Feng, on the other hand, accepted all comers and put all the puppets into the Sky-Swallowing Gourd, and then immediately sealed their self-destruction power.
Just like that, in a few dozen breaths, Chu Feng collected nearly ten puppets.
"Haha, this Liu An is simply a money-giving boy. He sent so many puppets at once!"
Chu Feng laughed.
These puppets all have the strength of the Taoist realm.
If he can master them all, he will have another big trump card.
With so many puppets self-destructing at the same time, even a strong person in the Guiyi Realm might have to think twice about it.
"That's great, Chu Feng, this spatial treasure of yours is so damn useful..."
Pang Lie also became excited.
With so many puppets, if all of them were destroyed by Liu An's head and self-destruction, he would definitely be overwhelmed.
The world origin of the Xuanling Realm will be consumed again.
The entire Xuanling world will never have peace.
"Don't take it lightly. It's not over yet, and Liu An will never give up easily!"
Chu Feng said with a serious face.
"Don't worry, my soul power has always been paying attention to the situation in the ascension channel..."
Pang Lie nodded.
"Old Pang, just keep an eye on it while I go to the space treasure!"
After Chu Feng warned Pang Lie, he entered the Origin Tower in a flash.
Then he took out the sky-swallowing gourd and entered it.
In the sky-swallowing gourd, ten puppets stand in a row on the wheel of creation.
"It's time to give them a big gift..."
He emitted his spiritual power and imprinted it on one of the puppets.
Since the other party can detonate the puppet, he can naturally do it too.
When the time comes, a puppet will arrive at the exit of the ascension channel and explode itself. Even if it doesn't kill them, it can scare them back and make them afraid to act rashly.
At the same time, at the exit of the ascension passage, Liu An and the others looked gloomy.
They still had puppets in their hands, but they didn't dare to use them.
According to their calculations, let alone ten puppets, one without any puppets would be enough to dry up the source of the Xuanling Realm.
But now, ten bodies have been invested, and together with the two that exploded before, there are twelve bodies.
But not only did the Xuanling World not collapse, it actually grew stronger.
